description: Two subscribers each have the same value queued. The driver cancels t.c at 50, while it sleeps, so its sleep ends early and its recv is refused with ASX_E_CANCELLED although a value is waiting (the cancellation check comes before the queue, channel/broadcast.rs recv). t.u, never cancelled, sleeps its full 200 and receives that same value: the refusal consumes and reorders nothing for the other receiver.
